O.outcome_detail: confidence in helping students use AI

cells.quote: "Confidence in helping students use AI was flipped from pre to post: while participants responded overwhelmingly with low confidence or unsure before the institute (80%), most participants responded with moderate/high confidence after the institute (90%)"
cells.note: The supplied study text describes the six-week institute and its qualitative case-study design but does not include this specific pre/post survey sentence; quote taken from the wiki entry as instructed.

O.outcome_detail: positive perceptions of AI in teaching

cells.quote: “Post-institute, there were no participants that responded with negative perceptions of AI pushed down to 0% from 20%. Participants with positive perceptions increased from 40% to 90%. Participants who reported being neutral about AI usage in their teaching decreased from 40% to 10%.”
cells.note: This result sentence appears in the wiki entry, not in the supplied study text.

O.outcome_detail: prekindergarten Emotional Support classroom quality

cells.quote: Intervention effects were positive and statistically significant for Emotional Support and Classroom Organization (p <.05) and positive and marginally significant for Instructional Support (p < .10). One effect size was in the large range – Full UBC classrooms scored 0.81 of a standard deviation higher than Comparison classrooms on Emotional Support.
cells.note: Classroom quality was measured at the end of the first year of intervention.
